subject: MajorMUD native REST/MEDITATE command presentation closure

native_branches.behavior: REST compares signed user +0xBE against zero; positive rejects REST.
native_branches.message: You are too sick to rest!

native_branches.behavior: REST tests native resting bit 0x0400; observer social is emitted only when entering REST from a non-resting state.
REST observer room dispatch supplies native room-message priority 0 (High).
REST sets bit 0x0400, clears meditating bit 0x0100, and resets the REST fast counter.
MEDITATE checks native capability 187 (0xBB) before shared sickness/full-resource presentation.
MEDITATE compares signed user +0xBE against zero; positive rejects MEDITATE.
native_branches.message: You are too sick to meditate!

native_branches.behavior: MEDITATE compares current mana +0x602 with maximum mana +0x600. If current >= maximum, current is clamped to maximum and meditation is rejected.
native_branches.message: Meditation will not help at this time.

native_branches.behavior: MEDITATE tests native meditating bit 0x0100; observer social is emitted only when entering MEDITATE from a non-meditating state.
MEDITATE observer room dispatch supplies native room-message priority 0 (High).
MEDITATE sets bit 0x0100, clears resting bit 0x0400, and resets the MEDITATE fast counter.

sickness_identity.slow_update_behavior: When user +0xBE is positive, native slow update prints 'You feel ill.' and subtracts the +0xBE value from current HP.
sickness_identity.cure_poison_cross_check: The decoded spell-effect switch is keyed by ability ID; ability 20 (Cure Poison) reaches 0x00449F01 and reduces target user +0xBE toward zero.
sickness_identity.reforged_mapping: Use the decoded active poison projection (classic.status.poisoned) for the REST/MEDITATE sickness gate. Generic non-poison status effects do not automatically count as this native sickness field.

resource_edge.rest_full_hp: No native full-HP rejection exists in the recovered REST branch. REST may enter at full HP.
resource_edge.meditate_full_mana: MEDITATE explicitly rejects at current mana >= maximum mana and clamps over-max current mana to maximum.

pass28_string_inventory: You are too sick to rest
pass9_timing_inventory: You are too sick to rest
megamud_corroboration.conclusion: MegaMUD independently recognizes the native recovery terminal surface; no MegaMUD-specific protocol or alternate wording is required.

runtime_contract: REST rejects only the recovered sickness gate within this presentation boundary; full HP does not reject REST.
MEDITATE capability admission occurs before sickness/full-mana presentation.
Both REST and MEDITATE reject active decoded poison sickness with exact native text.
MEDITATE rejects at full/over-full mana with exact native text and clamps over-full mana.
Entering REST/MEDITATE emits the exact observer social once per state entry at High room-message priority.
The success lines remain exact native terminal text.
Reforged client/Borin shared state parsing recognizes both 'You are now resting.' and 'You are now meditating.'.
